title: IM LOOPY FOR DOOP LOOPS!!!
summary: A fast arcade action adventure about a cereal mascot, an endless appetite, and a mall full of throwable groceries.
imageAlt: IM LOOPY FOR DOOP LOOPS!!! Steam header artwork
tagline: An all-out grocery-store rampage starring one dangerously hungry cereal mascot.
overview: IM LOOPY FOR DOOP LOOPS!!! is a compact arcade action adventure built around speed, grabbing, throwing, and a supermarket that rapidly stops resembling a place of business.
studioNote: IM LOOPY FOR DOOP LOOPS!!! was made under Jatater Worldwide, the game studio run by Connor Myers / Metater and JakeHub.
heroImageAlt: A supermarket arena filled with cereal and roaming enemies

gallery.alt: The player throwing groceries during a bright supermarket explosion
Fast first-person combat against supermarket enemies
The blue cereal mascot standing beneath a suspended enemy

highlights.title: Grab everything
highlights.description: Shelves, groceries, props, and enemies become part of a fast physical combat loop.

highlights.title: Arcade momentum
highlights.description: Short objectives and escalating encounters keep the game moving instead of pausing for exposition.

highlights.title: Readable chaos
highlights.description: Strong silhouettes, bright effects, and a simple input language keep the action legible at full speed.

highlights.title: Focused release
highlights.description: A compact game shaped under Jatater Worldwide from production through launch.
